crossRefs.note: From Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the valley, even to Gilead, there…

parallels.note: Israel struck him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, even to the children…

people.name: Amorites
people.line: Canaanite people group, enemies of Israel

people.name: Arnon
people.line: A river and valley, serving as a boundary for Israel.

people.name: Jabbok
people.line: A river east of the Jordan, associated with Jacob

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

translations.web: They possessed all the border of the Amorites, from the Arnon even to the Jabbok, and from the wilderness even to the Jordan.
translations.bsb: seizing all the land from the Arnon to the Jabbok and from the wilderness to the Jordan.
translations.kjv: And they possessed all the coasts of the Amorites, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and from the wilderness even unto Jordan.
translations.asv: And they possessed all the border of the Amorites, from the Arnon even unto the Jabbok, and from the wilderness even unto the Jordan.
